products.tagline: Just top, bake & enjoy! No more eating salad while your family eats pizza!
products.description: Everyone else is eating pizza and feeling great. You're not. We get it. Gone are the days when you are relegated to ordering the caeser with some chicken and no croutons. This GF pizza crust is legit! Par baked and ready to be your canvas! Sauce, top & bake in a hot oven or BBQ and you are back in the game!

products.name: La Rosa Gluten Free Bucatini, 250g
products.tagline: The Best Gluten Free Pasta You'll ever have!
products.description: This premium pasta maker in Emilia-Romagna specializes in gluten-free pasta. In fact, they only make gluten-free food in their factory. A blend of all-natural corn and rice flour from northern Italy and an adherence to traditional pasta-making techniques such as air drying and a slow working of the dough produce a gluten-free pasta that appeals to every appetite. Their bucatini cook to an al dente doneness that should delight diners of all gluten (and non-gluten) orientations.

products.name: Manini's Gluten Free Cheese Tortellini
products.description: Manini’s is committed to producing and delivering great tasting food for a healthy lifestyle. All of their products are made using their proprietary Whole Ancient Grain Flour, in their 100% dedicated gluten free and SQF certified facility. Been on the outside looking in when your family is eating Tortellini? No more. Toss these with a cream sauce, light tomato sauce, or a simple combo of butter, olive oil, a bit of pasta water and some grilled vegetables!

products.name: Manini's Gluten Free Four Cheese Ravioli
products.description: Manini’s is committed to producing and delivering great tasting food for a healthy lifestyle. All of their products are made using their proprietary Whole Ancient Grain Flour, in their 100% dedicated gluten free and SQF certified facility. 4 cheeses are better than 1! Toss these with a cream sauce, light tomato sauce, or a simple combo of butter, olive oil, a bit of pasta water and some grilled vegetables!

products.name: Manini's Gluten Free Portobello Mushroom Ravioli
products.description: Manini’s is committed to producing and delivering great tasting food for a healthy lifestyle. All of their products are made using their proprietary Whole Ancient Grain Flour, in their 100% dedicated gluten free and SQF certified facility. Filled with creamy cheese and earthen, sauteed portobellos - great with a white sauce, or with butter & olive oil and a splash of pasta water!

products.name: Manini's Gluten Free Spinach & Cheese Ravioli
products.description: Manini’s is committed to producing and delivering great tasting food for a healthy lifestyle. All of their products are made using their proprietary Whole Ancient Grain Flour, in their 100% dedicated gluten free and SQF certified facility. Their spinach & cheese ravioli will be your go-to ravioli fix. Creamy, cheesy filling with healthy, great tasting spinach - great with a light tomato sauce!

products.name: Ritrovo Selections GF Corn/Rice Spaghetti, 500g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this gluten-free pasta is made from corn and rice flour. Slightly more delicate and sweet than durum spaghetti, it is famously served with meatballs but works well with any of your favorite sauces.

products.name: Bachan's Gluten Free Japanese BBQ Sauce, 17oz
products.description: Simply put, these Bachan sauces are amazing. A staff favorite, it is the product of Justin Gill's Japanese family heritage, distilled and contained in an easy to use, delicious bottle of homemade sauce. Bachan means 'granny' in Japanese and this sauce tastes like your granny made it. The gluten free version is made with tamari rather than traditional soy sauce, and you wouldn't know the difference. It is what you want to drizzle over your rice bowl with grilled vegetables, whatever meat you had the night before & and a fried egg. Add some chopped scallions & some toasted sesame seeds and you're set. Not as salty as soy sauce & loaded with fresh scallions, garlic & ginger! Great as a condiment & fantastic as a quick marinade! Did we mention it's one of the coolest labels ever as well? That part is free of charge.

products.name: The Fine Cheese Co Gluten Free Olive Oil and Sea Salt Crackers, 3.5oz
products.description:
This GF cracker is intentionally subtle, so as to never overwhelm the cheese.

Made from a blend of gluten-free cereals, tapioca, buttermilk, extra virgin olive oil and sea salt. Serve with Pecorino or any hard cheese so all of your friends can enjoy the charcuterie!

products.name: Galbusera Gluten Free Zero Grano Crackers, 8 x 40g
products.description: Can't have wheat and looking for a great platform for your favorite cheeses? Look no further. Imported from Italy, Galbusera Gluten-Free crackers are made with corn, rice, and just a touch of salt. Pleasant on their own, but mild enough to allow you to enjoy tasting whatever you put on them! These crackers come in convenient 8 individual packs!

products.name: Natural Nectar GF Cracklebred, 100g
products.description: These gluten free blank slates of awesomeness are ready to do exactly what they are told. No delusions about being the lead singer in the band. They live to serve. So...pile them with your favorite cheese, charcuterie, dips or spreads and call it good!

products.name: Momofuku Restaurant Grade Tamari, 8oz
products.description: Meet Momofuku Tamari. If you’re used to grocery store tamari, you’ve never had anything like this. Their restaurant-grade version is made from organic ingredients and steeped with kombu to unlock a world of depth and flavor. It's built on 10 years of flavor research at the Momofuku Culinary Lab and now they are making them available to home cooks for the first time! Naturally gluten free and packed with flavor!

products.name: Caputo Fioreglut Gluten Free Flour, 1000g
products.description:
The Antimo Caputo line of flours is one of Italy’s premium brands for authentic

Neapolitan pizza, bread, and desserts. Their Fioreglut Gluten Free Flour is a great all-

natural alternative for those allergic to or avoiding gluten. You’ll be pleasantly surprised

at how pizza crust and bread made with this flour achieve a texture and taste that

resembles traditional loaves and crusts.

products.name: Primo Pan GF Drolo, 12oz
products.tagline: Gluten Free Dark Chocolate Hazelnut Cookies!
products.description: In the village of Battifollo on the Cuneo side of the Ligurian Alps, the Biga family bakes small lots of wonderful cookies according to local recipes. These gluten-free cookies are made with 40% Piedmont hazelnuts, egg white, sugar, cocoa and vanilla. Crunchy and light, this is a flourless cookie that tastes like a chocolate brownie on a cloud. Perfect with a glass of cold or steamed milk or with a caffe latte.

products.name: Primo Pan GF Volo, 12oz
products.tagline: Gluten Free Dark Chocolate Almond Cookies!
products.description: In the village of Battifollo on the Cuneo side of the Ligurian Alps, the Biga family bakes small lots of wonderful cookies according to local recipes. Inspired by Primo Pan's best-selling Drolo Cookies, their new Volo cookies are made with almonds, egg white, sugar, cocoa and vanilla. Crunchy, light, and gluten-free. Pairs well with milk and caffè lattes.
